SELECT date_trunc('day', ph.scraped_at) AS time,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ph.ppm2) AS "median KM/m2"
FROM price_history ph
JOIN v_active_listings la ON la.article_id = ph.article_id
WHERE ph.ppm2 IS NOT NULL
  AND ph.scraped_at > now() - INTERVAL '90 days'  AND CASE WHEN COALESCE(la.rooms, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN la.rooms !~ '^[0-9]' THEN 'other' WHEN split_part(la.rooms, '+', 1)::int >= 4 THEN '4+' ELSE la.rooms END = ANY (ARRAY[$rooms])
  AND (la.sqm IS NULL OR la.sqm BETWEEN ${min_sqm:int} AND ${max_sqm:int})
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM search_results sr
    JOIN saved_searches ss ON ss.search_key = sr.search_key
    WHERE sr.article_id = ph.article_id AND ss.category = ANY (ARRAY[$category]))
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT ph.article_id, ph.price, ph.scraped_at,
         lag(ph.price) OVER (PARTITION BY ph.article_id ORDER BY ph.scraped_at) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history ph WHERE ph.price IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT l.title, l.url, h.prev_price AS was, h.price AS now,
       (h.prev_price - h.price) AS drop, h.scraped_at AS seen
FROM h JOIN listings l ON l.article_id = h.article_id
WHERE h.prev_price IS NOT NULL AND h.price < h.prev_price  AND CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.rooms, '') = '' THEN 'unknown' WHEN l.rooms !~ '^[0-9]' THEN 'other' WHEN split_part(l.rooms, '+', 1)::int >= 4 THEN '4+' ELSE l.rooms END = ANY (ARRAY[$rooms])
  AND (l.sqm IS NULL OR l.sqm BETWEEN ${min_sqm:int} AND ${max_sqm:int})
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM search_results sr
    JOIN saved_searches ss ON ss.search_key = sr.search_key
    WHERE sr.article_id = h.article_id AND ss.category = ANY (ARRAY[$category]))
ORDER BY h.scraped_at DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT name, COALESCE(category, '(none)') AS category, listing_count AS listings,
       COALESCE(median_ppm2, 0) AS median, new_count AS new, drop_count AS drops,
       last_scraped_at AS last_scraped
FROM saved_searches
WHERE category = ANY (ARRAY[$category])
ORDER BY name

SELECT r.id, COALESCE(ss.category, '(none)') AS category, r.search_key, r.status,
       r.pages, r.cards, r.started_at AS started, r.finished_at AS finished, r.error
FROM scrape_runs r
LEFT JOIN saved_searches ss ON ss.search_key = r.search_key
WHERE ss.category IS NULL OR ss.category = ANY (ARRAY[$category])
ORDER BY r.id DESC
LIMIT 20
